Author: ashdam
Name: Gubal Library
Punchline: Community language localizer. Ships empty -- you bring the corpus.
Description:
THE PLUGIN SHIPS EMPTY. It contains no translations. Installing it changes nothing: until you load a corpus, the game reads exactly as it always did.

What it is, is a lookup engine. It loads a corpus file, matches what is on screen against it, and injects the result. It makes no network calls of any kind -- nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is translated at runtime.

YOU BRING THE CORPUS, and this project does not distribute one. The translations are somebody's separate work. Either use a corpus the community has published for your language, or build your own: the file format is documented in full so that starting from nothing is a real option, for any locale.

There is a self-test bundled -- two lines from one NPC, so you can tell a correct install from a broken one. Talk to Ahldskyf on the pier in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks and they come out as Hello World. That is a smoke test, not content, and the settings window stays red for as long as it is all that is loaded.

Coverage once you have a corpus: dialogue, quest text and cutscene speech (Talk), cutscene narration (TalkSubtitle), and speaker names. Battle callouts, speech balloons and the variant-dungeon banner are wired up but not yet characterised. This is a testing build -- please report problems on GitHub.
